summary: MicroVision filed an 8-K announcing it will seek shareholder approval at the 2026 Annual Meeting to amend its charter to allow the board to effect a reverse stock split at a ratio between 1-for-5 and 1-for-15, with the exact ratio to be set later. No definitive terms, price, or premium are disclosed. The board recommends the proposal and has retained Saratoga Proxy Consulting LLC to assist in proxy solicitation. This is a routine charter amendment proposal requiring a shareholder vote, not a special-situation event. Watch for proxy filing and shareholder vote outcome.
